query:
SELECT state_name, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status, rating, primary_date FROM senate_races WHERE state_name IN ('Arkansas', 'Mississippi') ORDER BY state_name;
SELECT state_name, district, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status, rating, primary_date FROM house_races WHERE state_name IN ('Arkansas', 'Mississippi') ORDER BY state_name, district;
